changes: Renamed the KOALA_* runtime env-var contract to LATTICE_* across 98 files with no koala fallback: dropped the `|| process.env.KOALA_X` fallback for 17 LATTICE_* dual-read twins, and renamed 38 KOALA-only vars to LATTICE_X across env reads, setters, JSON config, .Codex/.claude wrapper assets, hook-contract docs, 30 test/smoke files, and all active-doc env references (README.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/guide.md, docs/guide-hooks.md, docs/audits). Also dropped the docs/koala/legacy/ archive (12 files). First substantive story of the ship-clean koala-removal program (after B-ffa2 role-ID rename).
usage: Operators set LATTICE_* env vars instead of KOALA_* (e.g. LATTICE_AGENT, LATTICE_AUTHORITY_MODE, LATTICE_ACTIVITY_SOURCE). Hooks receive LATTICE_STAGE/COMMAND/STORY_ID/PHASE/etc.
expectedOutcome: A scan for KOALA_ env-var names across active code/config/wrapper-assets/docs returns zero; docs/koala/legacy/ is gone; build, e2e, validate, and verify_codex all pass.
actualTranscript: git grep KOALA_[A-Z] across active files (excl deferred legacy/.koala/CHANGELOG/experiments/decisions) = 0; no `|| process.env.KOALA_` shim; LEGACY_KOALA_* path constants preserved (7) and docs/koala/framework-audit kept (over-reach guards); docs/koala/legacy removed; npm run build exit 0; npm run test:e2e ALL PASS; lattice validate PASS 36/36 intent coverage; verify_codex 8/8. 3 REVIEW rounds, all 4 lanes passed, all 6 findings resolved/dismissed.
outcomeDiff: No gap. The env-var contract is fully LATTICE_* with no koala fallback; deferred .koala path layer untouched.
limitations: Intentional breaking change: external shells/CI/Codex wrappers exporting KOALA_* must switch to LATTICE_*. Scope limited to the env-var layer + its doc references + the docs/koala/legacy archive. Deferred to later program stories: broader koala PROSE in CLAUDE.md/README/decisions, the .koala runtime-dir rename (LEGACY_KOALA_* constants), docs/koala/framework-audit path, koala.config.json/marker parsing, and F-001 (4 decision-doc lineage refs to the removed archive).
pitfalls: The globally-installed `lattice` CLI is npm-linked to the main tree's dist, so its codex-adapter heartbeat self-check reads the OLD KOALA_ env names until the global CLI is rebuilt/relinked after this merge — temporarily relinked to the worktree to clear the TEST gate, restored to main afterward; rebuild main's dist post-merge. Some twin-fallback sites needed the KOALA_ line DROPPED (not renamed) — a mechanical rename there produced always-false `if(X && !X)` and duplicate dead reads (found and fixed as REVIEW findings F-002/003/004/006).
